topic: Five questions to ask at parent-teacher interviews
caption:
Progress reports are coming home. 📋 Here are 5 calm questions that turn a 10-minute interview into a real plan.

Which question do you always forget to ask?

#ParentTeacherInterview #ParentingTips #ElementarySchool #CanadianParents #OntarioEducation

title: 5 questions
to ask
the teacher
slides.sub: Turn a short interview into a real plan

slides.title: Start with what's going well
items: What does my child enjoy most?
Strengths are the best place to build from.
Who do they work well with?
It tells you how they learn best.
slides.example: Example: "Maya lights up during read-aloud." Now you know to read together at home too.

slides.title: Then ask about the next step
items: What is one skill to practise?
One clear goal beats a long list.
How can I help at home?
Ask for something small you can do in a few minutes.
slides.example: Example: "Practise adding on a number line." That's one game a night, not a worksheet war.

slides.title: Close the loop
items: When can we check in again?
Agree on a quick email or note in a few weeks.
Then tell your child one thing the teacher said they do well.
